config.segmentBasis: Three segments: Asset Management (measured by fee-related earnings, FRE), Retirement Services through the insurer Athene (spread-related earnings, SRE), and Principal Investing (PII); together, less interest and taxes, they make adjusted net income (ANI)
config.fiscalNote: Fiscal year matches the calendar year; merged with Athene in January 2022, so earlier figures are on a different basis. GAAP profit includes mark-to-market on Athene's portfolio and swings widely; the company focuses on ANI
